topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer opens the session by outlining the core topics, histopathological context, and learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Viral discovery of oncogenes and cell transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical investigation of transforming retroviruses led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes and the development of assays to detect malignant cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional classifications and molecular mechanisms of cancer genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the operational categories of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and illustrate their mechanistic actions using the RB and p53 pathways.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability in tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how failures in DNA repair, replication, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability to accelerate multi-step tumor development.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes and instability maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze how inherited mutations accelerate tumor onset across clinical syndromes and evaluate whether ongoing genetic instability remains necessary for tumor malignancy.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session with book recommendations and a preview of the upcoming lecture.
